 BGMI Air Pre-Registration Goes Live on iOS Ahead of India Launch Next Month
 BGMI Air will be seen as an alternate version of the original Battlegrounds Mobile India, but one that is designed to use less device resources compared to the original.
 By   Waquar Haider   
  Nov. 12, 2026 
 >
 Tech
 KRAFTON India has announced the pre-registration process for BGMI Air on Apple's iOS in preparation for the game's launch in the country slated for December 10, 2026. This move comes after the success recorded by the game's reception on Android, as BGMI Air had more than 14 million pre-registrations on the Google Play Store.
 The latest news comes after the success witnessed by BGMI Air on Android, with the game recording more than 14 million pre-registrations on the Google Play Store. BGMI Air is set to become available to Apple users as the game accepts registrations on the two most common mobile operating systems prior to the official launch.

 BGMI Air will be seen as an alternate version of the original Battlegrounds Mobile India, but one that is designed to use less device resources compared to the original.
 BGMI Air Download Size and Availability
 Another feature of BGMI Air that makes it stand out is that it needs minimal installation space. The application is estimated to use about 1GB of storage space when first installed. This reduces the amount of storage space needed for the game as compared to BGMI. This might enable those with low internal storage to use it.
 The distribution of BGMI Air will be through an independent application for the mobile device. The new application will neither substitute nor come as an update for BGMI. As a consequence, the user will be able to have two games independently on the same device. In addition, the existing BGMI accounts will also be separate from the new one.
 BGMI Air will be launched in India on December 10, 2026, according to the corporation. People who want to experience the game should pre-register via the Google Play Store for Android gadgets or the Apple App Store for iOS phones and tablets.
 Nevertheless, at the moment, KRAFTON has not released information on all the system necessities that are required to play the game. Information regarding any modifications to the game's gameplay mechanics and features as opposed to the original BGMI is not available either.
